question: With the krt-region-repair stage selected (router.special.stages), do fewer pour islands lose their connection to the rest of their net after routing (Q01.4's islands lost, counted on the electrical groups of crates/freerouting-krt planes::PlaneComponents) than with the default pipeline, on at least N-1 of the boards, with KiCad's unconnected_items of zone nets, unrouted and drc_real rising on none and no via in a pad; and does Q01's rule plus the repair do at least as well as Q01's rule alone?

default.engine: freerouting-rs at the commit that lands X02 (the Freerouting implementation, no KRT stage selected)

repair.engine: freerouting-rs at the same commit, with freerouting_krt::register called by the CLI (X00: the CLI's one registration line; until it lands, the same pipeline through crates/freerouting-krt's test harness)

settings.classes_rule: the net classes of the board's signal-layer copper zones other than the default class, decided from the input (canary-pwr: Dan's freerouting.json classes, Q00 open question 3)

secondary_comparisons.baseline: Q01.5's `on` arm (docs/roadmap/prereg/Q01.json), rerun at the same commit
secondary_comparisons.rule: islands lost not higher on any board; guards as below

boards.kicad: 10.0.7 (WSL-native kicad-cli and the system python3's pcbnew)
boards.dsn: demos: exported by tools/kicad-oracle/grade.sh from the stripped board; canary-pwr: also fixtures/canary-pwr/canary-pwr-9511d9a.dsn and the pours1..3 / pours-as-planes variants (grouped as one board, graded by canary-23)

eligibility: every board of the set; a board where no pour net has more than one island after the default arm counts as neutral, printed, never as an improvement
grading: tools/kicad-oracle/grade.sh (copper severities forced to error, the input board's DRC subtracted, refill on); canary-pwr by canary-23's ses_import.py, kicad-cli drc --refill-zones, via_in_pad.py and inner_tracks.py

metric_definitions.islands_lost: per board, summed over pour nets and layers: the pour's islands with an anchor (pin or via of the net) minus the electrical groups they form (PlaneComponents::regions), after routing; 0 when every anchored island is joined
metric_definitions.pour_unconnected: KiCad unconnected_items whose net is a zone net, after refill
metric_definitions.straps: the stage's 'strap at width' log lines

decision_table.pass: keep krt-region-repair (off by default); DIVERGENCES line with the numbers
decision_table.fail: remove X02.3-X02.4's code (planes/repair.rs, the destinations_only hook, x02-split-pour.dsn); the numbers stay in X02.5's done note; X02.2's report may stay if Dan wants it

timing: measured only after P04's default-tree decision (Q00 README, 'Order and critical path'); canary-pwr graded by the peer session (canary-23)
